3. Disconnect the pipe from the solenoid valve to the turbocharger vane position actuator, actuator side and remove it.

Refitting

Removing

Place the pipe from the solenoid valve to the turbocharger vane position actuator back in its housing and connect it to the actuator.

Connect the pipe from the solenoid valve to the turbocharger vane position actuator, solenoid valve side.

Secure the pipe from the solenoid valve to the turbocharger vane position actuator to the fastenings.
